Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. H.C. Joshi, learned Counsel i/b Mr. M.C. Pant, 
learned Counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Raghav Sanghal, learned Counsel i/b Mr. Piyush 
Garg, learned Counsel for respondents. 
3. The matter is listed today on Substitution 
Application (IA/2/2026) by which the petitioner intends 
to bring on record the legal heir of petitioner i.e. his wife.
4. The substitution application is within time.
5. Since the petitioner has died during pendency of writ 
petition and there being no serious objection to the 
application, accordingly, substitution application is 
allowed. Let the necessary substitution be incorporated 
by supplying amended memo of parties within a week 
from today.
6. List on 09.09.2026.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)

3. For the reasons indicated, delay in filing the 
substitution application is condoned. Delay

disposed of. 
4. Substitution application (IA/3/2026) has 
been filed by the petitioner to bring on record 
the name of petitioner’s daughter Sanchi 
(Minor), aged about 4 years (female), D/o 
Late Manoj Kumar, R/o Mohalla Natha 
Singh, Ward No.13, Jaspur, District Udham 
Singh Nagar, as petitioner No.1/2.
5. There is no objection from the side of 
respondents if the substitution application is 
allowed.
6. Accordingly, substitution application 
(IA/3/2026) is allowed.
7. Let the necessary substitution be 
incorporated by supplying amended memo of
